name: dsXNAbuilder
tagline: Double-stranded DNA, RNA and DNA/RNA builder with modXNA chemistry.
description: Generates canonical double-stranded (ds) DNA, RNA and DNA/RNA hybrid sequences, combining the canonical bases with the modified nucleotides available in modXNA, the modified-nucleic-acid library we co-develop.

name: panmer
tagline: Sequence-library generator for molecular dynamics, with the expanded modXNA alphabet.
description: Designs libraries of DNA and RNA sequences for molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, supporting the expanded alphabet of modXNA. It is based on the Orenstein & Shamir algorithm for designing compact sequences that cover every k-mer.
features: Based on the Orenstein & Shamir algorithm
